quote: Evaluation Metrics. Following WMT QE shared tasks, the sentence-level task will be evaluated using Pearson's correlation coefficient. For the word-level task, WMT19 used F1-MULT as the primary metric, while WMT20/21 conducted the Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) as the primary metric.

We evaluate the sentence-level task using Pearson's correlation coefficient. For the word-level task, WMT19 used F1-MULT as the primary metric, while WMT20/21 conducted the Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) as the primary metric. We also provide results of MAE and RMSE metrics.
